TC_R01.title: Paimon's Cheer
TC_R01.description: Double element combo rewards. Exclusive to the Traveler; duplicate copies do not stack.
TC_R01.flavor: The best travel companion makes every elemental flourish count twice.
TC_R02.title: Journey Compass
TC_R02.description: Raise the element combo limit to [blue]4[/blue] per turn. After your [blue]third[/blue] actual combo reward each turn, gain [blue]1[/blue] [gold]Strength[/gold] this combat. Does not draw cards.
TC_R02.flavor: Every journey starts with the next step.
TC_R03.title: Unbound Compass
TC_R03.description: Replaces Journey Compass. Whenever an Elemental Combo reward is actually granted, draw [blue]1[/blue] additional card. No per-turn trigger limit or turn cooldown. The shared cap of [blue]4[/blue] combos per player per turn is unchanged.
TC_R03.flavor: Every resonance points the way onward.
TC_R04.title: Traveler Medicine Chest
TC_R04.description: The first time each turn you Exhaust a Status or Curse, gain 5 Block.
TC_R06.title: Expedition Drum
TC_R06.description: After your third actual combo reward each turn, your next manually played single-target Attack this turn deals +8 base damage on its first hit.
TC_R07.title: Statue Blessing
TC_R07.description: The first time you trigger an elemental combo each combat, gain 6 Plating.
TC_R05.title: Tricolor Prism
TC_R05.description: The first card you play each turn (including autoplay) gains a random element for this combat, replacing its previous element. Replays do not reroll.
